calls.title: EOR Canada
calls.summary: The team discussed the process of hiring a Canadian citizen residing in the UK under a global talent visa, confirming that no sponsorship is needed, thereby ensuring compliance with UK visa rules. Jennifer highlighted the importance of monitoring visa compliance due to strict regulations and avoiding liabilities. The conversation included details on structuring EOR contracts, with an emphasis on using addendums for commissions and incentives to ensure clarity. The onboarding process was outlined, targeting a start date of February 17, and the need for work authorization checks was emphasized. Pricing strategies were also discussed, detailing discounts for multiple hires and billing flexibility starting only on the official hire date. Additionally, support from an implementation manager post-agreement was highlighted to ensure a smooth onboarding process and clarity in compensation structures.
calls.keywords: Canada, UK, Employer of Record (EOR), onboarding, incentive plan, international hiring
